column1: # Kalay palace post-revelation guards, Layana's uncertainty and Mind Read, rescue flags.
# Retain all original question and placeholder tokens.

column3: Dodonpa may have spies in\nKalay. If we send soldiers\nnow, he'll know before they{page_break}reach Lunpa.{end_wait}
The townspeople still don't\nknow Hammet was taken, do\nthey?{end_wait}
Lord Hammet will be home\nsoon, won't he?{end_now}
I hope so. Layana's been\nholding herself together\nfor everyone else's sake.{end_wait}
You might have said yes.\nShe needed to hear\nsomething kind.{end_wait}
Layana keeps her voice\nsteady around the guards.\nI've heard her crying after{page_break}they leave.{end_wait}
Merchants are supposed to\nbe safe on Angara's roads.\nDodonpa knows the law. He{page_break}just doesn't care.{end_wait}
Without Lord Hammet, will\nthe silk trade survive?{end_now}
Don't say that! Lady Layana\nalready has enough to worry\nabout.{end_wait}
You're right. I shouldn't\nhave spoken as though he\nwasn't coming home.{end_wait}
Hammet, am I protecting you\nby waiting? Or am I only\nafraid?{end_wait}
If the town knew Hammet was\na hostage, people would\npanic. We have to keep{page_break}calm.{end_wait}
Everyone feels that\nsomething's wrong. Nobody\nknows what they're allowed{page_break}to say.{end_wait}
I heard Lady Layana crying\nlast night. This morning\nshe greeted us as though{page_break}nothing had happened.{end_wait}
I almost joined Hammet's\nlast caravan. I think about\nthat every day.{end_wait}
Hammet built Kalay from a\ncrossroads. We can't\nimagine it without him.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, you went into\nLunpa? That was a dangerous\nthing to do.{end_wait}
But knowing Hammet is alive\nand unharmed means more\nthan you realize.{end_wait}
Thank you, {actor_name:1}.\nPlease, don't risk going\nback into Lunpa.{end_wait}
You still have your own\nquest. Don't abandon it for\nour sake.{end_wait}

Dodonpa will keep demanding
money as long as Hammet is
his prisoner. We may have{page_break}to pay until we can free
him.{end_wait}
I don't care how much money\nwe lose. I just want Hammet\nhome.{end_wait}
